Author: TellTunes
Name: TellTunes
Description: When someone sends you a tell with "!q <link>", TellTunes queues the song automatically. Works with YouTube videos and playlists, and Spotify tracks, playlists and albums (matched to YouTube). Optional: share songs with nearby Lightless Sync pairs through SoundyQ and the Mega Music Mod, announce songs in chat, and tell requesters their place in the queue. Downloads use yt-dlp, which TellTunes fetches on first use.
Punchline: Play songs people send you by /tell: YouTube, Spotify and playlists.
